about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: The answers candidate: version 1 as shipped (its fourteen cast rules and its group, in their order: now rules 6, 7 and 9 to 20; no triggers, no attack block, so Forge attacks) plus six rules for the deck's answer cards, rules 1 to 5 and 8. Written from the 200 games of the league of twelve (league-run #3, seed 20261250), where the seat won 36. Drawn / cast / in hand on the last own turn of a loss there: Beast Within 60 / 0 / 41 (AI:RemoveDeck:All, so Forge's AI never casts it), Mystic Confluence 50 / 0 / 34 (the same flag), Devastation Tide 66 / 33 / 21, Raise the Palisade 56 / 40 / 14; Lignify, Windswift Slice, Trap the Trespassers and Reclamation Sage were cast in 85 to 97% of the games they were drawn and are left to Forge. RULES 1 TO 3, Devastation Tide (returns every nonland permanent, ours too; our lands stay) on the conditions Tricky Terrain's Oblivion Stone and Evacuation use: an opponent with seven creatures or more and more power than we have, and one of: five creatures or fewer of ours, that opponent wider than us and able to kill us next turn, or the last opponent. Forge's own casts stay (no hold: the miracle cost is Forge's to take, and a hold might stop it); in the league they came at any position (a cast at 40 life with six permanents a side) and the seat won 7 of the 33 games with one. RULES 4 AND 5, Raise the Palisade in the first main phase, so the opponents' blockers are gone before our attack and what comes back next turn is summoning sick: when an opponent has four creatures, or could hit us for ten (the second condition is for decks of a few large creatures: a local game was lost to Eldrazi Incursion with the card in hand for eight turns, the opponent never having four creatures). Forge chooses the type (AILogic MostProminentComputerControls); with two Elves or more and two Insects or fewer it chose Elf in every cast seen, league and local, and the cast returned the opponents' boards (tokens die) and at most a non-Elf or two of ours. Ahead of the ramp, so the turn's mana goes to it first. RULE 8, Beast Within when an opponent could attack us for seven or more, as Tricky Terrain's rule (cast there in 72 of 75 games drawn). It names no target, so it is cast only when Forge's logic for the card agrees, and Forge picks the target (AITgts: a permanent of mana value 4 or more of an opponent's): locally it destroyed Cloud, Ex-SOLDIER, Gray Merchant of Asphodel, Rampaging Baloths and Twins of Discord. TRIED AND DROPPED: Mystic Confluence as a first-main play with an opponent at three creatures. Forge's charm logic chose its modes and both local casts resolved with no effect at all (no card drawn, nothing returned): five mana for nothing. A person holds it for an opponent's turn (counter unless they pay three, or bounce attackers), which the rules cannot reach. Left to Forge as before, out of the format's reach: Galadhrim Ambush (combat, other players' turns), Heroic Intervention and Swan Song (responses), Mystic Confluence; Sylvan Offering (gives an opponent the same tokens). Local test tables are recorded in the agent's report, not here.
